name: Love Machine
source:
The story talks about a professor who interacts with other characters which represent different parts of the the body of a young girl.

The title Love Machine represents the game itself, our body is a perfect natural system able to make us fall in love with someone or even hate it.

[From [url=https://ladywilliam.itch.io/love-machine] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事講述一名教授與其他角色互動，而這些角色代表一名年輕女孩身體的不同部位。

標題「愛情機器」代表遊戲本身：我們的身體是一個完美的自然系統，能夠讓我們愛上某人，甚至憎恨某人。

（來源：[url=https://ladywilliam.itch.io/love-machine]itch.io[/url]）
